what_to_do.en: Tap the word that means the same.

stages.choice_rule: The target is the last word in the stem (ignore <NAME>). Write four unique single words from the roots wordlist or allowed_extra_words. Exactly one is a true synonym of that target. The other three are wrong. Keep all four the same part of speech. Never repeat the target word. Never use a phrase. Mix answer_index.

roots: Offer exactly four unique single words from the roots wordlist or allowed_extra_words.
Exactly one choice is a true synonym of the last word in the stem. Never reuse that target word as a choice.
Keep all four choices the same part of speech as the target.
Wrong choices are real kid words, never nonsense and never a weaker cousin sold as the answer.
Tier 1 distractors are clear antonyms or unrelated everyday words.
Tier 2 distractors are grade-level same-POS words. One antonym is fine.
Tier 3 distractors are near misses: same topic, same people group, or a cousin action that does not mean the same.
Stay in kid world: school, home, food, pets, play, family, weather. No brands, no real names, no adult jargon.
Mix answer_index so the right word is not always first.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of three to five words that end with a common adjective such as happy, big, or little. Add a picture lemma when the stem has a concrete noun. Distractors are antonyms or unrelated.
tier_rules.2: Stems of three to six words that end with a grade-level action or describing word such as fast, begin, or close. Same-POS distractors; one antonym is fine.
tier_rules.3: Near-miss pairs such as shout and yell or pal and friend. Distractors are related people, places, or actions that do not mean the same. Stems may use <NAME> and two-syllable words.

same_feeling.en: Happy and glad mean the same. Both name a good feeling.
same_feeling.ko: happy와 glad는 같은 뜻입니다. 둘 다 좋은 기분을 말합니다.

same_size.en: These two words mean the same size.
same_size.ko: 이 두 단어는 같은 크기를 뜻합니다.

same_speed.en: Fast and quick mean the same. Both tell about speed.
same_speed.ko: fast와 quick는 같은 뜻입니다. 둘 다 빠르기를 말합니다.

same_action.en: These two words name the same action.
same_action.ko: 이 두 단어는 같은 동작을 뜻합니다.

same_person.en: Pal and friend mean the same kind of person.
same_person.ko: pal과 friend는 같은 뜻입니다. 둘 다 친구를 말합니다.

same_place.en: These two words name the same kind of place.
same_place.ko: 이 두 단어는 같은 종류의 장소를 뜻합니다.

same_thing.en: These two words name the same kind of thing.
same_thing.ko: 이 두 단어는 같은 종류의 물건을 뜻합니다.
